blocks.name: Original clip and timestamp scope
blocks.description: Frames, lossless FFV1 video, annotations and project: OpenCVDataflowGUI contributors, MIT. Original synthetic moving part; no customer or third-party media. Ten FPS, eight 64x48 BGR frames, known pixel boxes and presentation times. Native FFmpeg reads a bounded immutable buffer in chunks of at most 257 bytes. Presentation time is not camera acquisition time. Each frame has its own fresh ticket; Unbatch dispatches individual images in one graph activation. Read-limit, decoded-limit and malformed cases deliberately produce no result. Short-clip mode explicitly reports an unsatisfied requested frame count.
